name: Pyrefiends

variantInfo.name: Pyrefiend
notes: Standard level 43 pyrefiend (npc 433-436); the Slayer-task target.
Pyrefiends attack with magic-based melee (magic level 1) and have a 100% weakness to water spells.
Fiery and demon attributes; demonbane weapons apply. Pyrelord and the superior Flaming Pyrelord are stronger variants.

locationComparison.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (Pyrefiends)
notes: Pyrefiend area of the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon; 13 spawns, no smoke protection needed.
A cannon cannot be placed in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon (task table and cannon prohibited-areas list); the area is safespottable.

locationComparison.name: Smoke Dungeon
notes: Largest concentration; 23 spawns. A facemask or Slayer helmet is required for the smoke.
A Dwarf multicannon can be used here (task table Cannonable=Yes; the pyrefiend area is outside the task-only cannon ban). Not safespottable per the task table.

taskNotes: Pyrefiends are assigned by Mazchna and require 30 Slayer.
The live wiki also lists Vannaka as an assigner (40-90 per task); Vannaka is outside the C3 starter-tier scope of this family and is not authored here.
Pyrefiends have 45 hitpoints and a max hit of 4; they attack with magic-based melee (magic level 1) and have a 100% weakness to water spells.
Fiery and demon attributes - demonbane weapons apply. The Smoke Dungeon requires a facemask or Slayer helmet.
The standard pyrefiend is npc 433-436; Pyrelord and the superior Flaming Pyrelord are stronger variants not authored here.
The slayerTargetId 299 is SYNTHETIC (C2/C3 allocation contract, worklist section 1); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
The wikiPageId was not captured at authoring time (honest UNKNOWN); sourceUrl is https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Pyrefiend.
recommendedMethod: Cast water spells at pyrefiends (100% water weakness) in the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon; they have 45 HP and a max hit of 4. Alternatively melee them, or use a cannon in the Smoke Dungeon (facemask required).
